newsitem.title: USA: FAS Schumacher to be undersecretary-USDA official.
newsitem.headline: FAS Schumacher to be undersecretary-USDA official.

text.p: Gus Schumacher, head of U.S. Agriculture Department's Foreign Agricultural Service, will be nominated to be USDA undersecretary for farm and foreign agricultural services, an USDA official said Tuesday.
The official, who asked not to be identified, said an announcement would likely be made this month.
The post, one of the four top jobs at the USDA, oversees the multi-billion dollar farm subsidy program and the export program.
Before becoming head of FAS in 1993, Schumacher worked at the World Bank and as the Massachusetts state agriculture director.
Dallas Smith has been acting undersecretary.
